caption: A small green teardrop-shaped fruit with a curled calyx on its right side rests on a pale granular bed against a soft gray wall, a tiny red-and-green tag hanging in the upper right corner. For the first moments the fruit sits undisturbed. A dark, blurred hammer head then enters from the top of the frame and drops straight down, its face meeting the rounded top of the green fruit and pressing it into a flattened disc. As the hammer continues downward, the squashed fruit bursts apart, and a dense cloud of white granules erupts from the impact zone, spraying outward and upward while carrying pale green shards. The fragments scatter across the surface, the green body breaking into pieces mixed with the thrown powder. Green bits settle at the edges of the disturbed bed. Over the following seconds the billowing cloud thins and drifts back toward the ground, leaving crumpled green remnants resting on the pale surface. The hammer head, still coated with clinging granules, gradually rises and rebounds upward, its face lifting away from the surface as the suspended dust continues to settle around it, the background wall and hanging tag remaining fixed throughout.
relations: A resting green fruit on the pale bed flattens into a disc when a descending hammer face strikes its rounded top.
The flattened fruit bursts, ejecting a cloud of white granules and pale green shards outward and upward.
The erupting granule cloud thins and drifts back, leaving crumpled green fragments at the disturbed bed's edges.
The hammer head rebounds upward, its face coated with clinging granules while suspended dust settles around it.
